Where young people turn away from this society disappointed and retreat to the exclusive private, we must convince them that there is also room and understanding in society for their interests and needs.
The younger generation has a right to living conditions that give them the opportunity to develop professionally and socially.
next_texts:
In schools, universities, vocational training and social organizations, young people need opportunities for participation that give them the opportunity to actually shape their daily environment.
The younger generation not only has a claim that we take care of their problems, they also have to take their share of responsibility.

mention: Those who publicly deny the genocide of Jews
prev_texts:

next_texts:
The memory of the establishment of the national-socialist state of injustice 50 years ago is a special obligation for us to continue to vigorously pursue the draft law prepared by Social Democrats in the federal government to close this criminal law gap.
The general awareness of law is also heavily compromised where economic crimes cause billions of dollars of damage, mostly at the expense of less wealthy and less skilled citizens.

text: This is a depreciation of the long-term contributors.
prev_texts:
Since the social law reform in 2005 (Hartz reform), the amount of the right to unemployment allowance II and, except for the minor stage, the reference period of unemployment allowance I are not taken into account when determining whether and, where applicable, how long the person concerned was previously employed under the obligation of social insurance.
After a regular period of 12 months, formerly long-term workers receive unemployment benefits II in the same amount and for the same period of time as unemployed persons who have never previously paid contributions to unemployment insurance.
next_texts:
The AfD therefore advocates for a stacked longer reference period of unemployment allowance I depending on the duration of pre-employment.
The self-restraint in the calculation of unemployment allowance II is to be increased without penalty.

Since the social law reform in 2005 (Hartz reform), the amount of the right to unemployment allowance II and, except for the minor stage, the reference period of unemployment allowance I are not taken into account when determining whether and, where applicable, how long the person concerned was previously employed under the obligation of social insurance.
After a regular period of 12 months, formerly long-term workers receive unemployment benefits II in the same amount and for the same period of time as unemployed persons who have never previously paid contributions to unemployment insurance.
next_texts:
The AfD therefore advocates for a stacked longer reference period of unemployment allowance I depending on the duration of pre-employment.
The self-restraint in the calculation of unemployment allowance II is to be increased without penalty.
label: Yes

Therefore, we demand: a guarantee that after 45 years of work there is a disbursement-free pension right Fixing the statutory retirement age at 65 years for men and not raising the female retirement age Real value adjustment of pensions instead of payments below real inflation Increased accounting of child-care periods as retirement rights periods Increased minimum pensions and no accounting of partner income Cancellation of pension privileges for old politicians, at National Bank, ÖBB, etc.
The policy of “neighbourly love” means: promote our families and our own youth.

Instead of promoting them, SPÖ and ÖVP have unfairly reduced benefits for them.

text: Companies must hire job-seekers and not interim or border workers.

text: These families have been ignored by politicians, and by others in positions of power, for too long.
prev_texts:
We will govern in the interests of ordinary, working families
As Theresa May said when she first became prime minister, the work of the government under her leadership will be driven not for the benefit of a privileged few but by the interests of ordinary, working families: people who have a job but do not always have job security; people who own their own home but worry about paying the mortgage; people who can just about manage but worry about the cost of living and geting their children into a good school.
next_texts:
Yet they do not ask for much: they want to get on with their lives, to do their best for their children, to have a fair chance.
Under Theresa May’s leadership, they will no longer be ignored.

As Theresa May said when she first became prime minister, the work of the government under her leadership will be driven not for the benefit of a privileged few but by the interests of ordinary, working families: people who have a job but do not always have job security; people who own their own home but worry about paying the mortgage; people who can just about manage but worry about the cost of living and geting their children into a good school.
next_texts:
Yet they do not ask for much: they want to get on with their lives, to do their best for their children, to have a fair chance.
Under Theresa May’s leadership, they will no longer be ignored.

text: In a continuously technologically improving society, creative jobs last longer than others, and their share in both employment and the national economy is growing.
prev_texts:
For the best outcome, it is time to stop the rigid separation and focus on a common goal.
It is time to respect the Constitution, according to which the ultimate idea of the Estonian state is to create the best conditions for citizens to live a cultural, spiritually fulfilling life, but not to lead and organize the national "art production".
next_texts:
It is time to trust in the decision-making of the representatives of the cultural sector, who form the most creative, educated and thus better managed and independent decision-making part of society alongside the academic.
The greater the autonomy of this part of society, the freedom to decide within the limits of its field, the more satisfied the people, the better organized the environment.

text: Most municipal and urban people must be convinced of the benefits of joining.
prev_texts:
The People's League calls for the recognition of the principle of voluntariness based on the will of the people in the unification of local authorities and resolutely opposes the forced unification of local authorities.
The State may encourage voluntary membership by offering new joint holdings coverage for membership costs and development investments.

text: We will introduce the internal e-business of the entire judicial system (courts, prosecutors, attorneys, lawyers, notaries) (Back Office).
prev_texts:
Although the courts constitute the largest part of the judicial system, their work is processively linked to other judicial authorities, so we will set up a special service, following the example of European countries, to take care of the informatization of all judicial authorities.
With the revised organizational structure, we will more effectively pursue the objectives of the national e-Justice resolution project, which aims to improve the functioning of the judicial system through the complete computerization of the courts.
